_how_to_use: Remote ad control for WiFi Remote. Edit this file on keepitil.com and every install applies it the next time the app launches - no app update needed. ad_url = popup ad link. ad_title / ad_body / ad_caption = popup text. banner_url / banner_text = bottom banner. ad_every = button presses between popups (minimum 5). ssdp_enabled stays false until the Apple multicast entitlement is granted. Delete a field to use the app's built-in default.
ad_caption: All Ads funds our free apps — remove them anytime from Settings.
banner_text: FREECASH - Earn cash for playing games.
